# Type-aware forms, consistent chronology, dark theme and nightly sources

The Suggestion Box uses "could", not "should". Improvement idea, Prioritize a tracked bug and Report a problem guide the title, explanatory copy, observed/opportunity field, expected/proposed-outcome field, submit button, saved receipt and detail headings. Type and related issue appear immediately after title. Changing types never clears typed content. Only an existing-bug priority request requires a related issue. A report is community feedback, not an automatically confirmed bug record. Moderator approval, verified-account votes and private pending submissions are unchanged. Existing password/session assets and accounts are not replaced.

Sources, issue history, Browse Issues, released patch summaries, private submission lists and activity histories default to newest first. Newest first / Oldest first controls use the date displayed in that view; missing dates remain last. The public board retains Most supported as its priority ranking and additionally supports newest/oldest publication order. Sorts do not mutate stored evidence. Dark is the initial theme; Light mode is available on every page, and a deliberate choice is remembered locally without altering the authenticated session.

## Nightly scope
The scheduled job collects official Steam publisher announcements for HLLV app 3079210 and checks the existing ledger's linked source destinations. It stores a separately labeled official-feed.json; it never changes issue status, independent verification, developer review, votes, moderation or a curated patch summary. Source text is untrusted input: allowed HTTPS destinations, redirect checks, size/time limits, HTML/BBCode stripped, short previews, stable IDs and content hashes. New posts and changed publisher text are detected; earlier posts are retained if upstream retrieval fails. Keyword-matched issue links are only candidates, never evidence assertions.

Overview displays recent official announcements with direct sources and a separate last successful collection timestamp. Sources tabs display nightly link-check results and potentially relevant official posts separately from reviewed evidence. A failed run retains the previous successful timestamp and posts. A missing run is visibly overdue after 36 hours. Authentication, full source review and link reachability are not interchangeable. Reddit/support-thread bodies are not auto-converted into confirmed bugs.

## Scheduling and limits
GitHub's scheduled workflow must exist on the default branch (master). Only the scheduler file belongs there; it explicitly checks out feature/hllv-bug-evidence-tracker and commits only hllv_tracker/official-feed.json. It runs around 03:23 America/New_York nightly and has a manual dispatch action. It does not merge the application branch into master, require a new paid service, or use Supabase privileged credentials. GitHub schedules can be delayed or disabled; failure/overdue indicators are not optional. Render serves the committed feed after its normal deploy; nightly feed changes do not rebuild or renew the curated evidence snapshot.

## Release
The versioned installer runs against the current community release and fails on changed integration points. The workflow tests an isolated PostgreSQL database, synthetic Chromium/WebKit accounts, the unchanged password component, feed failure retention, dynamic copy/draft preservation, chronological controls and dark/light layouts before publishing. The schema adds a permitted community-only problem_report kind and modifies only list ordering in the guarded dispatcher. Hosted fixtures must roll back. No real user password, public suggestion or vote is supplied by tests. Source assets and prior immutable snapshots remain in Git.

The user's final exception bullet was incomplete and was not inferred. Existing related-issue behavior is retained: required for bug priority, optional for ideas and new problem reports.
